purpose: K4.2-H2 parallel-implementation ownership manifest. Four Claude sessions run concurrently with zero contact with each other (per Moncif's direction, Aug 2026). Every file any packet may touch is listed explicitly here. A file not listed for a packet is forbidden to that packet, full stop -- there is no implicit 'probably fine' category. scripts/check_packet_ownership.py enforces this mechanically against a branch's diff from main; it does not rely on a session reading and remembering this file correctly.
design_principle: None of the four parallel packets may touch a file another packet could plausibly also want to touch. Concretely: CURRENT_STATE.md, IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP.md, KNOWN_ISSUES.md, ADR_INDEX.md, PROJECT_INDEX.md, and tests/conftest.py are OFF LIMITS to all four packets without exception -- consolidating them is the sequential integration packet's job (K4_2_H2_READINESS_AND_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 13), which runs only after all four branches land. Within its own exclusive scope, a packet may create new files and/or edit files no other packet's manifest entry lists.

allowed_files_conditional.condition: ONLY if Case D (registration-order independence) genuinely fails and needs more than a trivial deterministic tie-break. Write the ADR (ADR_K4_2_H_03) justifying the change FIRST. See the brief's 'Open question' section before touching this file at all.

D7.title: Terminal Impasse Diagnostic Closeout
D7.note: core/orchestrator.py is explicitly forbidden. This packet verifies H1 already satisfies H2-G3; do not add per-attempt (non-terminal) event emission here -- that is new scope, not this packet's.

D11.title: Request Language Detection
D11.note: core/cognitive/planner.py is explicitly forbidden -- do not wire detected_language into discover_capabilities() scoring. That is a CapabilityMatch evidence-shape change requiring its own ADR and explicit approval, not an incidental part of this packet.

D12.title: Implementation Tracking Hardening (parallel-safe scope only)
D12.note: This is a deliberately NARROWED version of the D12 packet described in K4_2_H2_READINESS_AND_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 12. That version assumed D12 could record D3/D7/D10/D11's completion status -- which a zero-contact parallel session cannot honestly do, since it has no way to know whether the others have finished. The full tracking sync (CURRENT_STATE.md / IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP.md / ADR_INDEX.md / KNOWN_ISSUES.md) is deferred to the sequential integration packet, which runs after all four branches actually exist and can be inspected together. This branch's job is only: decide IMPLEMENTATION_TRACKER.md's fate (create it, scoped, or formally decline in its own status stub -- either is acceptable, silence is not), and draft the H-10/H-12 ADRs on their own merits.
